items.author: Trump
items.text: When will The Wall Street Journal start calling Artificial Intelligence (AI), a very bad and inaccurate name, SI (Super Intelligence), the name which virtually everyone else is using, or soon will be. In short order, we will be officially BANNING the term, “AI/Artificial Intelligence,” in all relevant documents, and everything else, due to its inaccuracy. Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普表示将禁止政府文件使用“AI/人工智能”一词并改称“超级智能”，可能影响AI行业的政策表述与监管环境。
